active.hypothesis: Specific question-led titles and concise action summaries will earn more qualified search visits than broad cybersecurity explainers.
active.change: Launch articles target one concrete reader decision and expose a three-line action summary above the fold.
active.primaryMetric: Search clicks per indexed article after 28 days
active.reviewNote: The 12-article launch library is complete. Traffic remains unmeasured, so the experiment stays active without a result until its decision date and verified measurement evidence.
